title: Optimizely Web Experimentation before 2026-11-17 mishandles the account signup flow, leading to presence of…
description: Optimizely Web Experimentation versions before 2026-11-17 contain a vulnerability in the account signup flow that allows attacker-controlled code to be present in the projectJS field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets. This flaw relates to improper handling of the signup process, potentially enabling injection of malicious JavaScript code.
